prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. \"Capture\" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"reset":1,"in":32},"outputs":{"out":32},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"out_reg","meaning":"32-bit capture register; each bit remains 1 after a detected 1-to-0 input transition until cleared by synchronous reset.","update_time":"posedge clk after sampling reset and in","update_during_reset":true},{"name":"prev_in","meaning":"32-bit previous sampled input value used to detect 1-to-0 transitions between successive cycles.","update_time":"posedge clk after sampling in","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"sync_reset_clear_out","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 1 at the sampled posedge; out becomes 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1,"in":7},{"reset":1,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":0}]}},{"id":"falling_edge_capture_and_hold","outputs":["out"],"condition":"reset == 0 at the sampled posedge; for every bit i, out_next[i] = out[i] OR (prev_in[i] AND (in[i] == 0)); bits already set remain 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next","uncertain":true,"example":{"vectors":[{"reset":1,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":1},{"reset":0,"in":0},{"reset":0,"in":0}],"expected":[{"out":0},{"out":0},{"out":1},{"out":1}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"out":0},"first_released_cycle":"first sampled posedge with reset == 0; normal falling-edge capture and hold apply on that edge"},"mid":"Optional mid object supplies changed nonclock inputs after the sampled posedge; those changes are carried to the start of the next row as pre-edge input values.","uncertain":[{"rule_id":"falling_edge_capture_and_hold","note":"The specification does not explicitly state whether the previous-input history is reset or still updated during synchronous reset. This contract assumes prev_in updates on every posedge, including reset cycles.","candidates":["prev_in updates during reset, so a 1-to-0 transition can be captured on the first released posedge","prev_in is cleared or not updated during reset, so a transition spanning the reset interval is not captured"]}]}
